leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a CSS stylesheet that defines multiple cascade layers using the @layer rule.
Apply styles within specific layers to control their cascade priority.
Manipulate the order of layers to determine which styles take precedence.
Integrate unlayered styles with layered styles and predict the outcome.
Configure a layer to import external styles and manage their cascade position.
Initialize a base layer for default styles and subsequent layers for overrides.
Implement a layer hierarchy to resolve style conflicts in a structured manner.
